name: Join
description: Join aligns owners, design teams, and contractors within a unified system of record for preconstruction and the design phase. By integrating real-time cost and schedule data with design evolution, Join provides the decision intelligence necessary to manage risk on complex projects and ensure predictable project delivery at scale. This connector allows you to interact with your project- and company-level Join data from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Join to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Join to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.join.build/mcp/join. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Join MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Join lists 15 MCP tools, including add-comment-to-item, categorizations-for-project, create-item, create-risk, current-user, get-item, get-risk, items-for-project, list-benchmarking-reports, list-my-projects, list-user-reports, and milestones-for-project.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Join?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Join in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Join requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Join is developed by Join Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
